newsitem.title: USA: Widespread optimism pushes Nasdaq, Dow higher.
newsitem.headline: Widespread optimism pushes Nasdaq, Dow higher.

text.p: Widespread enthusiasm on everything from the U.S. economy, to strong corporate profits to strong demand for personal computers pushed Nasdaq shares higher and propelled the Dow industrials past the 7,000 mark.
"Everything was viewed with rose-colored glasses today. The enthusism fed on itself. Stocks got a bit tired at the end of the day, but they could hold above 7,000 again tomorrow," one trader said.
"Techs stand out the most. We knew we were going to top 7,000 when the strength in techs held," another trader said.
Dell Computer Corp jumped 3-9/16 to 70-1/4 after its chairman said personal computer demand continues to be strong. Microsoft Corp, Intel Corp and U.S. Robotics Corp also showed gains.
Galileo Corp crumbled, falling 11-3/4 to 6-7/8, after the fiber and electro-optic company warned it would likely post a loss in fiscal 1997.

The Nasdaq Composite Index gained 11.74 points or 0.86 percent to an unofficial close of 1370.70. The Dow industrials powered past a new milestone, gaining 61 points to close unofficially at 7022. The long-bond gained nearly a point to yield 6.63 percent.
